title: ENGLISH_LISTENING_PRACTICE_SAMPLE
intro: Welcome to the English Listening Proficiency Test. There are two questions in this section. Please listen carefully to the conversations and choose the best answer for each question.

questions.title: Question number 1
questions.instruction: Listen to a conversation between two colleagues at an office.

dialogue.speaker: female
dialogue.text: Excuse me, Mark. Have you seen the quarterly sales figures yet?

dialogue.speaker: male
dialogue.text: Yes, I just reviewed them. Overall revenue is up by fifteen percent compared to last quarter.

dialogue.speaker: female
dialogue.text: That's fantastic news! Will you be presenting these results at tomorrow's team meeting?

dialogue.speaker: male
dialogue.text: Definitely. I am putting together the slide deck right now.

questions.question: What is the man currently working on?
options: B: Preparing a presentation slide deck
C: Booking a meeting room for tomorrow

outro: This is the end of the listening practice test. Thank you for your participation.
